recipe.visualDefinition: A 1970s-inspired double exposure composition featuring a full-body portrait of a man in a dark denim jacket standing in a dense, brushy landscape, juxtaposed with a large, close-up profile of the same man's face in the upper right. The entire image is framed by a decorative, notched-corner border with a distressed, earthy texture.
coreVisualRelationships: Scale contrast between the central full-body figure and the oversized profile in the foreground.
Integration of the subject into a high-texture, organic background of tangled branches and foliage.
Harmonious relationship between the sepia-toned photography and the brown-hued decorative frame.
coreInvariants: 1970s-style denim apparel with visible contrast stitching

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body figure centered vertically; large profile face occupying the top-right quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The man's face in the center, looking slightly off-camera.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large profile in the top right, moves down to the central figure, then up to the typography in the top left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is filled with dense organic textures and overlapping figures.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Earthy browns and sepia tones in the background and frame.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep indigo/black of the denim jacket providing a dark silhouette.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Off-white of the shirt and contrast stitching on the jacket.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high tonal contrast between the dark clothing and the mid-tone background.

letterConstructionRules: Inner decorative patterns or textures within the glyphs
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single decorative face used for all text to maintain a rustic, folk aesthetic.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the organic, Art Nouveau curves and weight.
Similar decorative structure and period feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a 1970s-style double exposure photograph. The background is a dense, sepia-toned forest floor with dry leaves and branches. In the center, a man with 70s hair wears a dark denim jacket with white stitching. In the top right, a large, transparent profile of his face is layered over the scene. Frame the whole image with a thick, brown, notched-corner border that has a weathered texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom-lettered text in the top-left corner using an Art Nouveau-inspired decorative font. The letters should have a dark outline and a textured, earthy fill that matches the frame's color.

verificationChecks: Ensure the double exposure effect looks integrated, not just like a sticker.
Check that the denim jacket has visible contrast stitching.
Verify the border has the specific notched-corner shape.
Confirm the typography has an organic, hand-drawn feel.

adjustableVariables: Complexity of the decorative frame texture
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Authentic 1970s film grain and color grading
Cohesive integration of text and image
Tactile, weathered texture on the frame

postGenerationChecks: Does the image feel like a physical object from the 1970s?
Is the scale contrast between the two portraits effective?
Is the typography legible despite its heavy texture?
Does the border frame the composition without overwhelming it?
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a central full-body portrait with a large-scale profile overlay in a high-texture organic environment, framed by a notched-corner decorative border and topped with Art Nouveau-style display lettering.
